fields.Name: IT161 - Ciphertext at Rest in the RunView Cache
fields.Description: A MJ: Credentials row with an encrypted Values field is read through RunView with a run-unique filter and the raw RunViewCache entry is inspected. CT0 the table column holds ciphertext; CT1 the miss returns plaintext and writes the cache; CT2 the cached entry holds ciphertext only; CT3 the hit returns plaintext without rewriting the cache; CT4 an entity_object result also decrypts; CT5 a peer server's set event carrying the slot's stored ciphertext rows at a newer version leaves CredentialEngine holding plaintext and GetCredential resolving the key; CT6 the same for a row_delta event. Mutating; self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The cache never holds plaintext for an encrypted field while every caller-facing path, including an engine fed by a peer server's cache event, returns plaintext.
